name: Backup verification
description: Proves this site's newest backup restorable by opening and reading it: every archive the backup depends on is downloaded from the backup target, decrypted with this site's own key and read to the end, then removed. Nothing on the site is touched. Runs on the interval in the backup_verify_every_days setting (30 days by default, 0 never) and records the result on the backup itself, where the Backups page shows it as verified restorable. Switched on together with Backup; a site that takes no backups of its own has nothing to verify.
